mechanics.claim: Ferocity is generated on casting a basic ability or using the Savagery empowered attack.
mechanics.quote: Upon casting a {{tip|Champion ability|basic ability}} or using ''{{ais|Savagery|Rengar}}'' first attack, '''Rengar''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}}

mechanics.claim: At maximum Ferocity, the next basic ability is consumed to become empowered with additional effect and an extra cast.
mechanics.quote: At maximum stacks, his next basic ability consumes them all to become empowered with an additional effect and grant him an additional cast

mechanics.claim: Ferocity stacks do not refresh their timer on subsequent triggers (bug).
mechanics.quote: stacking up 4 times but not refreshing on subsequent triggers {{bug|2}}

mechanics.claim: Unseen Predator attack deals basic damage but counts as ability damage for Spear of Shojin.
mechanics.quote: The attack deals {{tip|basic damage}} but is considered {{tip|ability damage}} for {{ii|Spear of Shojin}}.

mechanics.claim: Unseen Predator's leaping basic attack triggers on-attack effects and puts the attack timer on cooldown at the start of the leap.
mechanics.quote: The start of the leap is the end of '''Rengar's''' {{tip|attack windup}}, putting the attack timer on cooldown, triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects

mechanics.claim: Bonetooth Necklace bonus AD stacks recursively with other bonus-AD multiplier effects.
mechanics.quote: {{as|{{sti|ad|Bonus AD}}|ad}} percent from ''Bonetooth Necklace'' [[recursion|stacks recursively]] with {{bi|Infernal Might}}
